c74object.name: touch.vslider
c74object.description: A modern vertical interactive slider featuring proximity-easing dragging, discrete step incrementing, dual visual chassis styles (Ribbon and Rail), two-pass decoupled rotated label typography, and an integrated 50/50 Attrui floating parameter inspector with bound tickers and spectrum color pickers.

inlet.digest: Value input, bang, or configuration messages
inlet.description: Accepts numeric inputs to update the vertical slider position, bang to trigger output, or configuration/theme messages to set attributes dynamically.

outlet.description: Outputs the scaled floating-point value mapped linearly between min_val (bottom) and max_val (top).

method.name: bang
method.description: Outputs the current scaled value through the outlet.

method.name: float
method.description: Sets the vertical slider position according to the scaled range (min_val to max_val) and outputs the resulting value.

method.name: int
method.description: Converted to a float to set the vertical slider position, triggering output.

method.name: set
method.description: Sets the internal slider position without producing an output message.

method.name: popup
method.description: Opens, closes, or toggles the floating parameter inspector window. An optional argument of 1 or 0 explicitly opens or closes the window.

method.name: update
method.digest: Refresh theme from bus or persistent store
method.description: Forces the component to reload and re-render its visual styling from the global wireless theme bus or persistent dictionary store. Also accepts aliases theme_update and refresh_theme.

attribute.name: slider_style
attribute.description:
Selects between two vertical chassis designs:
0 = Ribbon (rectangular body with reticle corner brackets, vertical guide wire, and crossbar needle)
1 = Rail (minimalist vertical wire rail with floating solid orb knob)

attribute.name: mode
attribute.description:
Determines mouse and touch handling behavior:
0 = Touch (discrete stepping on tap, hold-repeat, proximity easing on vertical drag)
1 = Mouse (direct absolute jump to cursor position)

attribute.name: min_val
attribute.description: Sets the value corresponding to the bottommost slider position (default: 0.0).

attribute.name: max_val
attribute.description: Sets the value corresponding to the topmost slider position (default: 1.0).

attribute.name: step_amount
attribute.description: The numeric increment or decrement applied per discrete vertical tap or hold interval in Touch mode.

attribute.name: step_speed_ms
attribute.description: The interval in milliseconds between repeated discrete step increments when holding down in Touch mode.

attribute.name: slider_speed
attribute.description: Multiplier controlling the rate of proximity acceleration during vertical dragging in Touch mode.

attribute.name: curve_exponent
attribute.description: Exponential factor governing distance-dependent proximity vertical drag easing.

attribute.name: label_text
attribute.description: Descriptive text prefix displayed alongside the numerical value on the rotated vertical canvas.

attribute.name: label_mode
attribute.description:
Controls text abbreviation algorithms for the rotated label:
0 = Full (full string rendered)
1 = No Vowels (removes inner vowels while preserving first letters)
2 = Caps Only (extracts capital letters and digits; falls back to initials)
3 = First Letter (extracts the initial letter of each word)
4 = No Text (suppresses label text completely)

attribute.name: case_mode
attribute.description:
Text capitalization normalization:
0 = First Cap (Title Case)
1 = All Cap (Uppercase)
2 = All Small (Lowercase)

attribute.name: font_name
attribute.description: Name of the font family used to render the value and rotated label.

attribute.name: font_size
attribute.description: Point size of the rendered label and value text (clamped $\ge 6$).

attribute.name: font_style
attribute.description:
Font posture and weight:
0 = Regular
1 = Bold
2 = Italic
3 = Bold Italic

attribute.name: border_radius
attribute.description: Corner rounding radius for the vertical slider body and reticle corners.

attribute.name: border_thickness
attribute.description: Stroke line width of the outer reticle corner brackets.

attribute.name: border_extension
attribute.description: Pixel length of the reticle corner bracket arms extending along vertical edges.

attribute.name: track_breadth
attribute.description: Stroke width of the vertical center track wire.

attribute.name: slider_breadth
attribute.description: Horizontal width percentage (50% to 100%) of the sliding crossbar needle relative to total width.

attribute.name: bg_color
attribute.description: RGBA color of the inner slider body fill.

attribute.name: border_color
attribute.description: RGBA color of the outer corner brackets.

attribute.name: track_color
attribute.description: RGBA color of the center vertical guide wire.

attribute.name: handle_color
attribute.description: RGBA color of the crossbar needle (Ribbon style) or orb knob (Rail style).

attribute.name: text_color
attribute.description: RGBA color of the rendered numerical value text.

attribute.name: mode_color
attribute.description: RGBA color dedicated to the rotated label text prefix, decoupled from the value text color.

attribute.name: popup_dot_color
attribute.description: RGBA color of the top-right launcher dot used to open the parameter inspector.

attribute.name: pop_bgcolor
attribute.description: RGBA background color of the floating parameter inspector window.

attribute.name: attr_bg_color
attribute.description: RGBA background fill color for individual 50/50 attribute rows.

attribute.name: attr_border_color
attribute.description: RGBA outline color for attribute row containers and value boxes.

attribute.name: attr_slider_color
attribute.description: RGBA active fill color for sliders inside the 50/50 attribute inspector.

attribute.name: attr_text_color
attribute.description: RGBA text color for attribute names and value labels inside the inspector.

attribute.name: allow_popup
attribute.description: Enables or disables the top-right pop-up dot launcher and right-click access to the inspector window.

attribute.name: show_settings_attrs
attribute.description: Master toggle to show or hide the 50/50 attribute list inside the pop-up inspector window.

attribute.name: mask_performance
attribute.description: Toggles visibility of the Operating Style, Mode, Range Bounds, Step Timing, and Drag Speed section in the pop-up inspector.

attribute.name: mask_labels
attribute.description: Toggles visibility of the Label Style, Case Style, and Font Styling section in the pop-up inspector.

attribute.name: mask_geometry
attribute.description: Toggles visibility of the Corner Radius, Border Size, Bracket Extension, Track Breadth, and Needle Span section in the pop-up inspector.

attribute.name: mask_colors
attribute.description: Toggles visibility of the Slider Body, Reticle Border, Track Wire, Needle/Knob, and Decoupled Text Colors section in the pop-up inspector.

attribute.name: mask_popup_colors
attribute.description: Toggles visibility of the 5-color Inspector Theme Palette section in the pop-up inspector.
